name: Liquid Rocket Engines
summary: Design of liquid-propellant rocket engines: thrust chambers, injectors, cooling, ignition and engine operation.

topics.name: Liquid rocket engine architecture and subsystems
Thrust chamber sizing: chamber pressure, characteristic length (L*), contraction ratio
Injector types: impinging, coaxial swirl, pintle, showerhead
Injector design: pressure drop, atomisation and mixing
Heat transfer in thrust chambers: the Bartz correlation
Film, transpiration, ablative and radiation cooling
Ignition systems: pyrotechnic, spark, hypergolic, TEA-TEB
Engine valves, lines and propellant conditioning
Case studies: F-1, RS-25, Merlin, Raptor, RD-180
